narr: A shortwave trough brought storms to Northeastern Pennsylvania. An isolated, slow moving thunderstorm, caused areas of flash flooding near New Albany.
ev: Route 220 in New Albany was flooded in several locations.
Flooding occurred on Lawrence and Front Streets in the Borough of New Albany.
lsr: ROUTE 220 IN NEW ALBANY FLOODED IN SEVERAL LOCATIONS.
FLOODING ON LAWRENCE STREET AND FRONT STREET IN NEW ALBANY.
